item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Eating. Food is fuel, and your day has a lot of moving parts, so don't leave meals to chance. Decide now what your next meal is, and make it include protein and something green. Keep water close, and don't let a busy stretch push a meal aside. Eating on purpose steadies your energy and your mood. Action: before the next hour is up, put a protein-rich snack or meal on your plate and eat it sitting down.
